title: Bitcoin Price Holds Near $75,000 After Hot October Jobs Report
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Price Holds Near $75,000 After Hot October Jobs Report Bitcoin price held near $75,800 Friday after U.S. employers added 165,000 jobs in October, far above the 59,000 forecast, as December Fed hike odds climbed toward 80%. This post Bitcoin Price Holds Near $75,000 After Hot October Jobs Report first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
